title: API: isTracked sent as text is refused, never saved as tracked
custom_preconds:
• API calls replayed from DevTools with header X-Location-ID = your location.
  • A category id for the location.
custom_steps:
1. POST /api/inventory/parts/create with a valid body but "isTracked":"false" (a string).
  2. Search Inventory (status all) for that part number.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • 400 {"errors":[{"isTracked":"Must be a JSON boolean (true or false)."}]}

Step 2:

  • The part does not exist (it is never silently created as tracked).
